name: MonkeyFrenzy
summary:
"Monkey Frenzy" is an intense, heart-racing survival game set in a vast, dimly lit research facility where something has gone horribly wrong. The once peaceful establishment, now overtaken by a group of unruly, unpredictable monkeys, becomes a nightmarish maze of danger and chaos. As the player, you must navigate through the dark, maze-like corridors, carefully avoiding the increasingly hostile primates that roam the facility with heightened aggression.
